games.name: UNO
games.howToPlay: Match colours or numbers, play action cards, and be the first to empty your hand. Don't forget to shout UNO!

games.name: JENGA
games.howToPlay: Take turns removing one block at a time from the tower and stacking it on top. The player who topples the tower loses.

games.name: CHESS
games.howToPlay: Move your pieces strategically to checkmate your opponent's king. Plan ahead and control the board.

games.name: MONOPOLY
games.howToPlay: Buy properties, collect rent, and bankrupt your opponents. Trade wisely to build your empire.

games.name: SCRABBLE
games.howToPlay: Form words on the board using letter tiles. Score points based on letter values and premium squares.

games.name: CONNECT 4
games.howToPlay: Drop discs into the grid and be the first to connect four of your colour in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

games.name: LUDO
games.howToPlay: Roll the dice and race your tokens around the board to home. Capture opponents to send them back to start.

games.name: PICTIONARY
games.howToPlay: Draw clues for your team without using words or gestures. Guess correctly before the timer runs out.

games.name: CATAN
games.howToPlay: Collect resources, build settlements and roads, and race to 10 victory points on the island of Catan.

games.name: CARDS AGAINST HUMANITY
games.howToPlay: Fill in blank cards with the funniest answers. One player judges each round — adult humour only.

games.name: TWISTER
games.howToPlay: Spin the dial and place hands or feet on coloured circles. Last person standing without falling wins.

games.name: EXPLODING KITTENS
games.howToPlay: Play cards, avoid exploding kittens, and use defuse cards to stay in the game. Last player alive wins.
